coverage.main: Read all 28 pages of arXiv 2305.16934v2 (29 October 2023; NeurIPS 2023 camera-ready stamp), including Sections 1-5, Tables 1-2, Figures 1-8, references and Appendices A-C with Figures 9-16. Transfer setup and results checked on PDF pp. 5-9.
coverage.supplement: Appendices A-C (implementation details, hyperparameters, Algorithm 1, compute Table 3, additional qualitative results, sensitivity and failure cases) are embedded in the arXiv PDF and were read. No separate NeurIPS supplement was retrieved; the arXiv version states it is the NeurIPS 2023 paper with appendix.
coverage.excluded_results: Table 1 is white-box on the surrogates. MF-ii + MF-tt rows in Table 2, Figure 6 and Figure 7 points with query budget are query-based attacks on the victim itself, not pure transfer (Figure 7's t8-q0 point is the MF-ii transfer setting and is covered by the Table 2 group). Figures 1-3, 5, 8-16 and Appendix C are qualitative examples, sensitivity and failure illustrations without rates.

result_groups.locator: Table 2 MF-it and MF-ii rows (p. 7); Section 3.2 (pp. 5-6); Section 4.1 (p. 8); Section 4.2 (p. 9); Figure 7 t8-q0 point
result_groups.population: ImageNet-1K validation clean images, each paired with a random MS-COCO target caption; surrogate CLIP/BLIP encoders to six victim VLMs; number of images for Table 2 not stated
result_groups.outcome: mean CLIP text-encoder similarity between the victim's generated response and the target caption (continuous)
result_groups.evidence: Section 4.2 transfers adversarial examples crafted on surrogates to large VLMs and reports mean CLIP score, with a clean-image row per victim. There is no binary success, no clean-correct event and no statement selecting adversarial examples by surrogate success; the score is averaged over the sampled images. Neither conditioning question is defined for this continuous targeted-generation outcome.

f1.evidence: The paper reports a clean-input baseline of the same CLIP-score outcome for every surrogate (Table 1) and every victim (Table 2), which is positive baseline reporting. Classification clean accuracy is not defined for captioning/VQA outputs, so the field's accuracy requirement cannot be applied; not coded no.

f2.evidence: Single group unclear: no target-clean-correct event exists for free-text generation scored by CLIP similarity.

f3.evidence: No source-success event is defined for surrogate embedding matching, and no selection of transferred examples is stated. Not an explicit retention statement, so unclear rather than no.

f4.locator: Table 2 caption and Section 4.2; Appendix Table 3
f4.evidence: Table 2 reports averaged continuous scores, so integer counts are not the relevant record; the Table 2 sample size is not stated (Table 1 uses 50K images; release scripts default to 1,000 samples) and Appendix Table 3 says experiments were repeated three times without per-run values.

f5.locator: Section 4.1 Basic setups (p. 8); Appendix A Hyperparameters (p. 18)
f5.evidence: Default L-infinity epsilon 8 on [0,255] pixels, 100-step PGD with step size 1, stated as the default for all experiments; Figure 6's epsilon sweep (query-based, excluded) lists explicit values. The surveyed transfer group uses the default.

f6.evidence: The pinned public release contains transfer, query and CLIP-score evaluation scripts for the victims, relying on third-party public weights and Google Drive caption/data files. Drive contents were not verified, the exact Table 2 image/target sample is not identified, and the survey's conditioning quantities are undefined for this outcome. Not a claim that the release is deficient.

artifact_checks.result: Cloned and pinned (35 tracked files). Contains MF-ii transfer and MF-tt query scripts for LAVIS (BLIP/BLIP-2), MiniGPT-4 and UniDiffuser plus eval_clip_text_score.py; shell defaults use num_samples 1000, 100 steps. No adversarial images, generated captions or per-example scores are tracked. Not executed.

README-linked data repository and caption files on Google Drive; contents were not listed or downloaded through the review tools. Accessibility and correspondence to Table 2 unverified; not treated as absent.

bounds_checks.reason: Mean CLIP similarity to a target caption is not a misclassification probability and has no clean-error analog; the fixed-predictor bound is not applicable.

limitations: Non-blind evidence audit. Applicability is recorded as a non-classification targeted-generation outcome; fields 1-3 unclear reflect task mapping, not deficient reporting.
No runtime or Drive-data verification attempted; no numerical bound computed.
